# fct_booking_changes

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_booking_changes` · dbt area: `marketplace`

History table for Bookings and changes made to them over time. Includes current (effective) and previous values, delta amounts, and flags for when changes are detected. Each row represents a historic version of a Booking (can have multiple rows per Booking). Built in an SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) Type 2 method. Sourced from the booking_historicalbooking table in the Portal database.
